newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU flour firms book 100,000 T export licences-ONIC.
newsitem.headline: EU flour firms book 100,000 T export licences-ONIC.

text.p: The European Union has accepted all bids placed by European flour firms in France for 100,000 tonnes of exports, France's grain office ONIC said on Tuesday.
"The requests were granted," an ONIC official told Reuters.

Flour firms applied last Thursday for the licences which carried a daily refund of 27 Ecus per tonne. The bids were placed just before the EU cut the refund applying to flour exports to 22 Ecus from 27.
The EU Commission had three working days to decide whether to accept or refuse the bids.
Throughout the EU, flour firms may have bid last week for licences to export more than 400,000 tonnes of flour with a 27 Ecus rebate.
There was no immediate news on the fate of applications placed outside France. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
